missing_requirements: The public documents establish local source/template advice, not complete collector receiver acceptance. All new findings are warnings.
Legacy extraction decodes value-bearing query names/values once and omits bare keys. Unknown parameters and macros remain open. No universal receiver duplicate first/last policy is claimed.

Top-level query contracts also use the existing form-body fallback for complete captures. Query fields take precedence by name. Native JSON body members do not satisfy these contracts. This local carrier behavior does not prove receiver POST/form support.
Directory roots attribute child subdomains, while each endpoint manifest selects only its explicit host and path. Unsupported attributed routes receive directory.no_rulepack_coverage info.

No live collector requests, private sample values, campaign/account state, delivery or platform configuration were used. Fixtures derive from public templates and synthetic boundaries; they are not executed vendor SDK captures.

Campaign ID presence/nonempty is advice on the documented route. ID alphabet, length, ownership, campaign existence and account mappings remain external; encoded/custom values are not given invented grammars.

sid,pid,crid are default reporting metadata. Missing values warn; supplied empty and arbitrary text remain unclassified. Terminology explicitly includes placement text with spaces. Site-served UI space cleanup is not universalized.

cachebuster spelling is supported by ART19, and Cint recommends platform cache busting. Default anatomy also omits it, so presence/nonempty remains advisory. Randomness, uniqueness, timestamp range, macro format and per-request change cannot be established here.
Only explicit observed gdpr values all equal to literal1 enable Lucid consent-profile advice. Absence,blank,0,unknown or unresolved macro values do not independently establish jurisdiction.
Bare gdpr keys are omitted by the existing extractor: gdpr&gdpr=1 and gdpr=1&gdpr still activate the vendor branch. The all-values guard covers observed value-bearing pairs, not all raw query forms.

The explicit branch needs at least one populated gdpr_consent carrier. Local decoding checks each populated nonmacro consent separately for vendor508 and purposes1,7,8,9. Duplicate consent completeness/check policy is local behavior, not receiver arbitration.

The TCF FAQ distinguishes Lucid vendor508 from Cint734. No current GVL lookup, account legal basis, jurisdiction, full TCF2.2 processing permission or receiver guarantee is inferred. Consent structure and positive bits are only local evidence.
Optional idfa,video_action,video_completion,c1-c5 are documented but have no new value checks. Action names are illustrative, video amount can be time or percentage, and custom values remain opaque.
Captured device_id and gdpr_pd names have no exact field definition in the opened source set. They remain outside the documented-field inventory and unvalidated.
Some published GAM single-percent macros are outside the existing core detector vocabulary. A retained fired control documents this limit; the pack does not invent a new macro parser.
Amazon/Netflix S2S, reporting CSVs, site-served dashboard cleanup, and ART19 podcast forwarding headers are not transferred to all pixel or VAST inputs.
